name: polaris-navdata
description: SIDs, STARs and approaches from MSFS (SimConnect facility data) for the Polaris EFB, on ws://localhost:2050

scripts.build: esbuild main.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --outfile=dist/navdata-bundle.js && pkg dist/navdata-bundle.js -t node22-win-x64 -o dist/PolarisNavdata.exe --no-bytecode --public-packages "*" --public
